hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Singleton buyback-and-burn hook with a per-pool donation pot: on sells (MAIN→SECONDARY), beforeSwap absorbs the sell at the pool's exact price from pot funds (shield), preventing price impact; on buys (SECONDARY→MAIN), afterSwap uses pot funds to buy more main (pump), capped to prevent sandwiching. Supports an auto-compounding hook-held LP position with configurable fee splits for burns, buybacks, and compounding.
